title: subagent: Count Twitter refs in August Wikipedia pages

content:
You need to answer this question using web tools (webfetch, websearch, read, write, edit, glob, grep). Bash is NOT available - only webfetch, websearch, and file tools work.

Question: "How many times was a Twitter/X post cited as a reference on the english Wikipedia pages for each day of August in the last June 2023 versions of the pages?"

This means: For each day of August 2023 (August 1 through August 31), look at the English Wikipedia page titled "August 1", "August 2", ..., "August 31". Find the version of each page as it existed in June 2023 (i.e., the revision from June 2023 or the most recent revision before/on June 30, 2023). Then count how many references/citations on each page point to Twitter.com or X.com (i.e., how many citations link to a Twitter or X post).

Your task:
1. For each day (1-31), use the Wikipedia API at https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php to find the revision ID of the page "August N" as it existed in June 2023.
   - You can use action=query with prop=revisions, and use rvend=20230630 or similar parameters to get the revision closest to June 2023.
   - Try: action=query&titles=August%201&prop=revisions&rvlimit=1&rvprop=ids|timestamp&rvend=20230630000000&rvdir=newer&format=json
   - Or use the older revision API: action=query&titles=August%201&prop=revisions&rvstart=2023-06-01T00:00:00Z&rvend=2023-06-30T23:59:59Z&rvlimit=1&rvprop=ids|timestamp&rvdir=newer&format=json

2. Once you have the oldid (revision ID), get the content of that revision:
   - Use action=parse with oldid parameter, or action=query with prop=revisions&rvstart=...&rvend=...
   - Or use: action=query&titles=August%201&prop=revisions&rvstart=2023-06-01T00:00:00Z&rvend=2023-06-30T23:59:59Z&rvlimit=1&rvprop=content&rvslots=main&format=json

3. In the wikitext content, count references to Twitter.com or X.com:
   - Look for patterns like [https://twitter.com/...], [https://x.com/...], {{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/...}}, {{cite web|url=https://x.com/...}}
   - Count each unique occurrence.

4. Report the results in a table with each day and the count.

IMPORTANT: Use only webfetch and websearch (no bash). You can use webfetch to call the Wikipedia API URLs directly.

Start by testing the API to find the June 2023 revision of "August 1", then work through all 31 days. Be thorough.
